prompt: How do I restore a previous version of a file in OneDrive?
completion:
Below is a quick‑reference guide that covers every way you can restore a previous version of a file in OneDrive—whether you’re on Windows, macOS, the OneDrive web app, or a mobile device.  
Feel free to skip to the section that matches your platform, or scroll down if you want the full “all‑platforms” checklist.

---

## 1️⃣ OneDrive for Windows (File Explorer)

| Step | Action | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| **1** | **Right‑click** the file in your OneDrive folder | Works in Windows 10, 11, 8.1, etc. |
| **2** | Hover over **“Version history”** | A sub‑menu opens. |
| **3** | Click **“Version history”** | The dialog shows a list of saved versions, along with date, time, and author. |
| **4** | **Select** a version | Hover over the version, then click the three dots (…) and choose **“Restore”**. | The current file is replaced with that version. |
| **5** | (Optional) **Download** a copy | In the dialog, click **“Download”** to keep a copy locally before restoring. |

> **Tip:** If you only need to view a past version, click **“Open”** instead of **Restore**.  
> **Tip:** Older versions are kept for **30 days** on free OneDrive, longer (up to 365 days or more) on Microsoft 365 Business/Enterprise plans.

---

## 2️⃣ OneDrive for macOS

| Step | Action | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| **1** | Open **Finder** → **OneDrive** folder. | |
| **2** | **Control‑click** the file → **Show in Finder** if you’re not already. |
| **3** | **Right‑click** → **File Info** → **Version History** | Alternatively, open the file, click the **info (i)** button in the Finder toolbar, then **Version History**. |
| **4** | **Select** a version → click **“Restore”** or **“Download”**. | |

> **Tip:** The macOS desktop client also supports restoring via the OneDrive icon in the menu bar: Click the OneDrive cloud icon → **Help & Settings** → **Version History**.

---

## 3️⃣ OneDrive Web (Browser)

1. **Sign in** to [onedrive.live.com](https://onedrive.live.com) with your Microsoft account.  
2. **Navigate** to the file you want to restore.  
3. **Right‑click** the file → **Version history** (or click the ellipsis **…** → **Version history**).  
4. A sidebar opens, listing all revisions.  
5. Hover over a revision → click **Restore** or **Download**.  

> **Shortcut**: In the browser, you can also click the file to open it, then click the **info (i)** icon on the right side of the page, then click **Version history**.

---

## 4️⃣ OneDrive Mobile Apps (iOS & Android)

| Step | Action | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| **1** | Open the **OneDrive** app. | |
| **2** | Tap the **…** (more) icon next to the file. | |
| **3** | Tap **Version history**. | |
| **4** | Tap the version you want → **Restore** or **Download**. | |

> The mobile interface is a bit more compact, but the process is identical.

---

## 5️⃣ Restoring from OneDrive Recycle Bin (Deleted Files)

If the file was **deleted** rather than overwritten:

1. Go to the **OneDrive** web page.  
2. Click **Recycle bin** in the left pane.  
3. Find the file → **Restore** (top‑right button).  

> Deleted files stay in the Recycle Bin for 30 days on personal OneDrive, longer on business plans.

---

## 6️⃣ OneDrive for Business / SharePoint (Teams, Office 365)

- The steps are the same as above; just log in to the **SharePoint** site where the document is stored.
- You can also restore a previous version directly from **Teams**: Right‑click the file in **Files** → **Version history**.

---

## 7️⃣ Troubleshooting & Tips

| Issue | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| “Version history” missing? | The file type may not support versioning (e.g., non‑Office documents in certain setups). Check **SharePoint** settings or **OneDrive** sync settings. |
| No older versions available? | Versioning might be disabled for the library or folder. Contact your admin or check **Settings > Advanced settings** in SharePoint. |
| Version history shows only the current file? | Ensure **Sync** is active; sometimes offline changes are not pushed until the client reconnects. |
| You want to keep all versions? | **Download** them first or use a script to archive them. |
| Need to keep a version for compliance? | On **Business** plans, version history retention can be configured via **SharePoint Admin Center** or **Microsoft 365 Compliance Center**. |

---

## 8️⃣ Quick Cheat‑Sheet

| Platform | Key Shortcut | Result |
|----------|--------------|--------|
| Windows File Explorer | **Right‑click → Version history → Restore** | Restores previous version |
| macOS Finder | **Right‑click → File Info → Version History → Restore** | Restores previous version |
| OneDrive Web | **Right‑click → Version history → Restore** | Restores previous version |
| Mobile | **… → Version history → Restore** | Restores previous version |
| Deleted File | **Recycle Bin → Restore** | Restores deleted file |

---

**That’s it!**  
Now you can confidently recover any older version of a file in OneDrive, whether you're on a PC, Mac, phone, or using a business account. Happy restoring!
